q: How much does a project cost?
a: It depends on scope and complexity. After a free discovery call we send a fixed-scope quote with a clear breakdown, so you know the cost before we start. Typical MVPs take 6–12 weeks.

q: Do you work with startups or only established companies?
a: Both. We help early-stage founders validate ideas with lean MVPs and support established businesses with larger platforms, integrations and automation.

q: Who owns the code and the design?
a: You do. On final payment, all source code, design files and documentation are transferred to you. We can also work inside your own repositories from day one.

q: Can you take over or improve an existing product?
a: Yes. We start with a short technical audit of your code, infrastructure and UX, then propose a prioritized plan to stabilize, refactor or extend what's there.

q: How do we communicate during the project?
a: You get a dedicated project lead, a shared board, weekly demos and a Slack or WhatsApp channel — whichever your team prefers. No black-box development.

q: Do you offer support after launch?
a: Every project includes 30 days of free post-launch support. After that you can move to a maintenance retainer with SLA-backed response times, monitoring and regular updates.
We choose the stack that fits your product — commonly React, Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, Python, Flutter, PostgreSQL and AWS — and avoid vendor lock-in wherever possible.
